units.source_text: 这种不明了的自我反省，有时也会给我带来某种速自己都觉得与自己不相称的抒情式的兴奋。

en.t: This obscure self-reflection sometimes brought me a kind of lyrical excitement that even I felt was out of keeping with myself.

units.source_text: 这种时候，倘使恰巧赶上是个明月之夜，我就会带着尺八到金阁的旁边吹奏一阵子。

en.t: At such times, if it happened to be a bright moonlit night, I would take my shakuhachi to the side of the Golden Pavilion and play for a while.

units.source_text: 现在，我不用看乐谱也能吹奏过去柏木吹奏过的（源氏车》的曲子了。

en.t: Now I could play, even without looking at the score, the piece Genji-guruma that Kashiwagi had once played.
